notes: The previously accepted authenticated Android, Web and iOS reports remain the product-level evidence for the exact private-chat typing path. They are referenced with their original reportGitHead and immutable report hashes; this delta does not repeat those E2E matrices.

All three transports now use one common per-profile roster. A deterministic 128-participant test proves independent start, explicit stop, self filtering, refresh and exact timeout expiry; it passed in Chrome/Wasm and Kotlin/Native iosX64.
Android rejects a session inside its refresh window before opening or publishing on the typing channel. The focal JVM test proves zero network connects and zero broadcasts for an expired session.

Web rejects stale realtime snapshots, schedules renewal at the refresh boundary, disconnects both sockets before refresh and reconnects only after the authenticated request path resolves. The focal Chrome/Wasm test proves the exact boundary.

iOS rejects stale sessions before channel construction and revalidates the same user and bearer on subscription, inbound events and outbound broadcasts. Kotlin/Native source and tests compiled on the Intel macOS host.

A broader iosX64 run executed 15 tests and found one timeout in the pre-existing realtimeParticipantChangeRefreshesThreadAndInboxImmediately test. The exact new multi-party test was then run alone and passed; no production failure was observed in the changed path.
